Najczęstszy błąd to projektowanie wyłącz: The most common mistake is designing purely to taste. The business owner chooses a mark they like, but doesn't check whether it will be legible, usable and suited to the clients. The second problem is too many elements: a symbol, initials, a tagline, a gradient, shadows, details and several colors at once. Such a mark may look impressive on a large board, but it loses its strength in real applications.
Najgorszy scenariusz to projektowanie lo: The worst scenario is designing a logo as a series of random proposals: one version with an icon, a second with initials, a third with a gradient, a fourth in a completely different style. Such a process seemingly gives you a choice, but in practice makes the decision harder. It's better to prepare fewer directions, each with a clear premise and a demonstration of how it will work in the brand's real world.
Najlepiej zacząć od określenia modelu sp: It’s best to start by defining your sales model: a retail online store, B2B, a catalog with inquiries, premium product sales, dropshipping, personalized products or a local business store.
